about_text:
UZ Drive: Hill Adventure, version %s.
All vehicles, maps, artwork and sounds are original. Not affiliated with any real car brand.
Fonts: Exo 2 and Nunito (SIL Open Font License).
Engine: Godot Engine (MIT license).
achd_airtime: Stay airborne for %s in one jump
daily_body: Log in every day to collect rewards! Big prize on day 7.
daily_come_back: Today's reward is collected. Next one in %s
exchange_hint: Trade gems for coins. Gems are earned only by playing.
map_desc_countryside: Poplar rows, haystacks and bridges over streams.
map_desc_desert_road: Sand dunes, long jumps and scarce fuel.
map_desc_forest: Roots, mud and steep slopes. Drive carefully!
map_desc_green_hills: Gentle hills and open skies. The perfect start.
map_desc_night_highway: Night run: headlights, ramps and the biggest rewards.
map_desc_rocky_mountains: Steep cliffs, boulders and deep gorges.
map_desc_snow_mountains: Slippery snow and ice. Easy on the throttle.
map_unlock_hint: Complete “%s” to unlock for free, or buy it now.
mission_drive_single: Drive %s in one run without running out of fuel
privacy_text: UZ Drive does not collect any personal data and does not connect to the internet. All progress is stored only on your device. There are no ads, no tracking and no third-party analytics. There are no real-money purchases. The full policy is published on the app's store page.
reset_body: All coins, vehicles and achievements will be deleted.
reset_body2: This cannot be undone. Are you absolutely sure?
revive_body: Spend %d gems to refuel and restore your vehicle.
tut_air: In the air: GAS tilts back, BRAKE tilts forward. Land on your wheels!
tut_boost: Tap BOOST for a short burst of extra power!
tut_brake: BRAKE slows you down and reverses
tut_fuel: Watch your fuel! Collect fuel cans on the way.
veh_desc_buggy: Lightweight buggy with superb air control.
veh_desc_bus: Long bus: watch the belly on hill crests!
veh_desc_city: Compact, thrifty city car. Light, but struggles on steep hills.
veh_desc_classic: Vintage classic where style matters more than speed.
veh_desc_crawler: Rock crawler with giant tyres and incredible grip.
veh_desc_crossover: All-wheel-drive crossover ready for any road.
veh_desc_hatch: Nimble hatchback with good balance and easy handling.
veh_desc_kart: Tiny go-kart: super light, nimble and fun in the air!
veh_desc_monster: Monster truck: drives over anything, but tips over easily.
veh_desc_mpv: Family MPV: roomy, calm and fuel-efficient.
veh_desc_muscle: Big V8 muscle car that loves to lift its front wheels.
veh_desc_offroad: Small, stubborn 4x4 that goes where roads don't.
veh_desc_pickup: Pickup truck that hauls cargo and loves rough roads.
veh_desc_rover: Lunar rover: low gravity and long, floaty jumps.
veh_desc_sedan: Reliable sedan: stable, efficient and comfortable.
veh_desc_sports: Low, fast sports coupe. Great on smooth roads, careful on bumps.
veh_desc_super: Supercar with huge power and grip. For skilled drivers only.
veh_desc_suv: Big, tough SUV with tall suspension and strong traction.
veh_desc_tractor: Tractor: slow, but climbs absolutely anything.
veh_desc_trophy: Trophy truck with long-travel suspension built for big air.
veh_desc_van: Hard-working van: slow, but very easy on fuel.
